skill_domain: skill engineering, LLM workflow automation, eval-driven development

findings.title: DSPy: Compiling Declarative Language Model Calls into Self-Improving Pipelines
findings.key_finding: Declarative specification of LLM pipelines enables automated optimization; separating program logic from prompt implementation allows systematic improvement without manual prompt engineering
findings.design_impact: process.md 的声明式流程设计参考：每步骤有明确 input/output，使自动优化成为可能

findings.title: LangChain / LangGraph: Agent Orchestration Frameworks
findings.key_finding: Graph-based agent orchestration enables parallel sub-agent execution with shared state; node-level evaluation enables step-by-step quality control
findings.design_impact: 5 类 sub-agent 并行调研架构的工程参考；未来 invoke_step_judge 的实现可参考 node-level evaluation

findings.title: Evals: OpenAI Evaluation Framework
findings.key_finding: Structured eval registry with YAML case definitions; model-graded eval (LLM-as-judge) is standard practice for subjective quality assessment
findings.design_impact: objective_cases.yaml 的 YAML 格式设计参考；invoke_skill_judge 对应 model-graded eval 模式

findings.title: PromptFoo: LLM Testing Framework
findings.key_finding: CLI-based LLM testing with YAML test definitions; supports multiple assertion types including LLM-graded assertions; red-teaming capabilities for adversarial testing
findings.design_impact: validate.sh + run_eval.sh 的工具链设计参考；red-teaming 思路启发了 failure-mode-first eval 哲学

top_insights: 声明式流程规范 + 结构化 eval 是 LLM 工作流工程的成熟模式
LLM-as-judge 已成为 LLM 输出质量评估的标准实践，需要双向校验防止偏差
并行 sub-agent 架构提升调研覆盖度，但需要结构化输出格式保证质量

suggested_eval_cases.description: run_eval.sh 能正确执行 run_script 断言并报告结果
gen_skill_dir.sh 生成的骨架包含 judge_calibration 断言模板
suggested_eval_cases.source_title: DSPy: Compiling Declarative Language Model Calls
